title: Jab Krishna khud pahunche Narakasura ke durg
hooks: Ek raakshas jise koi purush nahi maar sakta... toh phir kaun maarega?
Krishna ne ek baar apna chakra ghuma diya - poora durg hil gaya
16000 raaniyan bandi theen. Unka mukti kaun dilayega?
hook_why: Instant curiosity gap: impossible boon + who breaks it. Second person pulls viewer in.
metaphor: Outer fortress = inner ego. One clean strike frees both.

caption: Jab Krishna ne Narakasura ko maara, toh sirf raakshas nahi mara - ahankar ka durg toota. Bhagavata Purana, Dasham Skandh. Tere andar ka durg kab tootega? #puraankikatha #krishna #narakasura #ahankar #@puraankikatha Music: Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com), CC BY 4.0

claims.claim: Krishna defeated Narakasura and freed captive women.
